title: Add an item
summary: Create a stock item from the inventory list.

steps.text: Open {inv} from the sidebar to see the inventory list.
Click {add} to create a blank item. Its detail page opens so you can fill in the fields.
You can also ask the assistant to find items, add an item or change items' prices, status or location, many at once if you like. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
